## What's new

### New Starlight home screen
A brand-new home screen built in SwiftUI, with **Liquid Glass** on iOS 26 (materials on older versions). It sits on top of the original Moonlight engine, so pairing, PC discovery and streaming work exactly as before.

**Home**
- **PC picker** at the top (glass capsule): switch PCs, see online / not paired status, refresh games, PC options (Wake-on-LAN, etc.) and add a PC.
- **Featured game** with its SteamGridDB background filling the screen, the game's logo (or name), "Running on PC" status and when you last played it.
- **Play / Resume** button, **pin** button and a **•••** menu (copy shortcut link, save icon, more options).
- **Continue Playing** row: the running game first, then the most recently played. Tap a card to feature it, tap again to play.
- **All Games** row with covers (on taller screens).

**Library**
- Grid of every game on the selected PC, with **search**. Tap to play, long-press for options.

**Settings**
- Stream settings (the original Moonlight settings), add PC, PC options, Game Artwork (SteamGridDB) and app version / credits.
- **Use Classic Moonlight Layout** switches back to the original screen. To return, open **Game Artwork** in the classic layout and choose **Use New Starlight Layout**.

**Everywhere**
- Long-press any game for Play, Pin/Unpin, Copy Shortcut Link, Save Icon to Photos and More Options (quit, hide…).
- Starlight now remembers when you last played each game and which PC you used last.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
